rationale: The price has reclaimed the 9-EMA ($13.97) and is showing signs of consolidation above the recent lows, invalidating the immediate momentum-based short thesis. With the price approaching the invalidation level of $14.02 and failing to break lower despite high relative volume, the risk of a short-squeeze or mean reversion to the VWAP is increasing. Closing the position now preserves capital and avoids a stop-out at the invalidation level.
